limitations_and_boundaries: The relationship between TAZ and PD-L1 is not conserved in mouse cell lines, likely due to differences in promoter sequences.
Cell line identities were not recently authenticated or Mycoplasma tested.
Experiments were conducted using cells with passage number less than 40.

research_questions.statement: What immune-related genes are transcriptionally regulated by TAZ and YAP in human cancer cells?

provenance.text_excerpt: We identified 71 genes that are transcriptionally regulated by TAZ or YAP overexpression that are relevant to immunology.

claims.statement: TAZ and YAP regulate immune-related genes in human cancer cells.

datasets.description: Gene expression data from MCF10A cells overexpressing TAZ-S89A or YAP-S127A, profiled with nCounter Human Immunology v2 panel.

methods.name: NanoString analysis
methods.protocol_description: RNA was collected from each condition in biological replicates using RNAzol RT reagent and cleared of residual gDNA using RNeasy Mini Kit. 300 ng RNA per reaction using nCounter Human Immunology v2 Gene Expression Panel. nSolver 3.0 software used for background subtraction, normalization, and data analysis.

experiments_or_tasks: Examination of TAZ-induced PD-L1 expression in mouse cell lines and comparison with human cells.

methods.name: qRT-PCR and Western blot in mouse cell lines
methods.protocol_description: TAZ-S89A overexpression in mouse cell lines (HC11, NMuMG, E0771, E10, B16-OVA); PD-L1 mRNA and protein measured by qRT-PCR and Western blot.

methods.name: Mouse Pd-l1 promoter luciferase assay
methods.protocol_description: Mouse Pd-l1 promoter reporter (nucleotides -1723 to +220) cotransfected with TAZ-S89A/TEAD4 into SK-BR-3 cells; dual luciferase assay.

study_units.name: Species-specific regulation of PD-L1 by TAZ

provenance.text_excerpt: the mouse Pd-l1 promoter had a dramatically diminished response to both human and mouse constructs (Fig. 6G).

results.value_raw_text: The mouse Pd-l1 promoter had a dramatically diminished response to both human and mouse TAZ-S89A/TEAD4 compared to human PD-L1 promoter

results.metric_name: PD-L1 mRNA expression in mouse cells

provenance.text_excerpt: TAZ-S89A overexpression caused no change in Pd-l1 mRNA expression in any of the cell lines examined (Fig. 6B).

results.value_raw_text: TAZ-S89A overexpression caused no change in Pd-l1 mRNA expression in any of the mouse cell lines examined

provenance.text_excerpt: TAZ regulates PD-L1 expression by binding to the PD-L1 promoter through the TEAD family of transcription factors thereby enhancing promoter activity.

claims.statement: PD-L1 is a transcriptional target of the Hippo pathway component TAZ in human cancer cells.

evidence_spans.content: TAZ knockout decreases PD-L1; addback rescues; TAZ/TEAD activate PD-L1 promoter; TAZ binds PD-L1 promoter

provenance.text_excerpt: TAZ knockout decreased PD-L1 protein in both cell lines... PD-L1 expression in TAZ-knockout MDA-MB-231 cell lines was rescued by addback... TAZ-S89A and TEAD1-4 coexpression dramatically increased PD-L1 promoter activity... TAZ binds at the PD-L1 promoter by ChIP.

experiments_or_tasks: Validation of PD-L1 as a bona fide transcriptional target of the Hippo signaling pathway in human cells through overexpression, knockdown, and knockout experiments.

methods.name: Western blot and qRT-PCR
methods.protocol_description: Western blot analysis using antibodies against PD-L1, YAP/TAZ, etc. qRT-PCR using SYBR Green reagents.

methods.name: CRISPR-Cas9 knockout
methods.protocol_description: TAZ knockout using lentiCRISPRv1 vector; clonal cell lines established by limiting dilution; addback of CRISPR-resistant TAZ constructs.

methods.name: Dual luciferase assay
methods.protocol_description: 100 ng promoter reporter cotransfected with TAZ/YAP and TEAD constructs into SK-BR-3 cells; Renilla luciferase as internal control; measured after 48 hours.

methods.name: Chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP)
methods.protocol_description: SimpleChIP Enzymatic Chromatin IP Kit; MCF10A-TAZ-S89A cells induced with doxycycline for 72 hours; chromatin incubated with TAZ antibody or normal mouse IgG.

study_units.name: Validation of PD-L1 as a transcriptional target of Hippo signaling

provenance.text_excerpt: TAZ knockout decreased PD-L1 protein in both cell lines (Fig. 3C and D).

results.value_raw_text: TAZ knockout decreased PD-L1 protein in MDA-MB-231 and SK-BR-3 cells

provenance.text_excerpt: PD-L1 expression in TAZ-knockout MDA-MB-231 cell lines was rescued by addback of CRISPR-Cas9–resistant TAZ constructs (Fig. 3F and G).

results.value_raw_text: PD-L1 expression in TAZ-knockout MDA-MB-231 cell lines was rescued by addback of CRISPR-Cas9–resistant TAZ constructs

provenance.text_excerpt: TAZ-S89A and TEAD1-4 coexpression dramatically increased PD-L1 promoter activity (Fig. 4E).

results.value_raw_text: TAZ-S89A and TEAD1-4 coexpression dramatically increased PD-L1 promoter activity in SK-BR-3 cells

provenance.text_excerpt: We confirmed that TAZ binds at the PD-L1 promoter by ChIP. Specifically, we found that fragments from the proximal PD-L1 promoter (i.e., positions -221 to +21 and -183 to +58), the CTGF promoter and the CYR61 promoter precipitated with TAZ whereas a more distal fragment from the PD-L1 promoter (positions -1039 to -808) did not (Fig. 4K).

results.value_raw_text: TAZ binds at the PD-L1 promoter as shown by ChIP; fragments from proximal PD-L1 promoter precipitated with TAZ

provenance.text_excerpt: cancer cell TAZ expression regulates T-cell viability through PD-L1.

claims.statement: TAZ-induced PD-L1 upregulation in human cancer cells inhibits T-cell function.

evidence_spans.content: TAZ overexpression increases T-cell apoptosis and decreases IL2 production; PD-L1 blockade reverses these effects

provenance.text_excerpt: TAZ-S89A overexpression in MCF10A was sufficient to increase apoptosis in Jurkat T cells... inhibition of PD-L1/PD-1 binding completely suppressed TAZ-S89A–induced T-cell apoptosis... TAZ-S89A overexpression in A549 was sufficient to suppress IL2 production by T cells and this was reversed when cells were cocultured in the presence of a PD-L1 blocking antibody.

experiments_or_tasks: Coculture of TAZ-overexpressing cancer cell lines with Jurkat T cells to assess T-cell apoptosis and IL2 production.

methods.name: Coculture assay
methods.protocol_description: Jurkat T cells activated with PMA and PHA, then cocultured with TAZ-overexpressing cancer cells. T-cell apoptosis measured by flow cytometry; IL2 production measured by ELISA.

study_units.name: Functional impact of TAZ-induced PD-L1 on T-cell function

provenance.text_excerpt: TAZ-S89A overexpression in MCF10A was sufficient to increase apoptosis in Jurkat T cells cocultured with these cells (Fig. 5B and C). A similar increase in apoptosis was observed in T cells cocultured with TAZ-S89A–overexpressing A549 or H1299 lung cancer cells (Fig. 5D–G).

results.value_raw_text: TAZ-S89A overexpression in MCF10A, A549, and H1299 increased apoptosis in Jurkat T cells cocultured with these cells

provenance.text_excerpt: inhibition of PD-L1/PD-1 binding completely suppressed TAZ-S89A–induced T-cell apoptosis (Fig. 5H).

results.value_raw_text: Inhibition of PD-L1/PD-1 binding completely suppressed TAZ-S89A–induced T-cell apoptosis

provenance.text_excerpt: TAZ-S89A overexpression in A549 was sufficient to suppress IL2 production by T cells and this was reversed when cells were cocultured in the presence of a PD-L1 blocking antibody (Fig. 5I).

results.value_raw_text: TAZ-S89A overexpression in A549 suppressed IL2 production by T cells and this was reversed by PD-L1 blocking antibody
